---
name: Dispute a gap
about: Tell us why one of the published gap dossiers is wrong (already done, infeasible, or not worth doing)
title: "Dispute FG:____:___ — "
labels: gap-dispute
---

**Candidate ID** (from the dossier card, e.g. `FG:qwen:005`):

**Which kind of wrong?**

- [ ] **Already done** — a paper/repo/blog closes this gap
- [ ] **Infeasible** — can't be done for a concrete technical reason
- [ ] **Boring** — real gap, but there's a good reason nobody has bothered
- [ ] **Ill-posed** — the claim doesn't make sense as stated

**Evidence** (for "already done": a link to the work that closes it — arXiv ID,
repo, or blog post; for the others: the concrete reasoning):

**How close is the match?** (does the cited work do exactly this, or something
adjacent? A sentence on the delta helps us score it honestly.)
